name: millkit
summary: Plots 0-3 now have 4 whole beds each (loft not needed; beds fit the existing rooms). Plot 0 roof is one polished-andesite material with a proper ridge and verge. The coop is a raised hen house (x64..69, z11..16) with ramps, nests, roost, a covered feed shed and the fenced run. fit OK, all 11 rooms walkable and lit; the 8 check orphans are untouched store and wash-line parts.

revisions.comment:
The owner: "Apply those revisions" (the three gaps found in the review):
1. More beds for villager families: 3 to 4 beds in each house (plots 0-3), not 1-2. Use a sleeping loft under the roof reached by a ladder, a back room, or bunk-style beds side by side; every bed whole (bed()), with two clear blocks above it and reachable from the door, so villagers can claim them. Keep each house inside its plot.
2. The tin roof of the first shotgun house (plot 0) looks patchy: make it one clean, continuous roof (a single material with a proper ridge and edges), like the other houses.
3. The chicken coop (plot 5) is too small a hut: make it a proper coop that fills more of its plot, a raised hen house with a ramp, nesting boxes (hay and barrels), a roost, a covered feed area and a fenced run with a gate.
Keep the plot grid exactly (12 wide, z 5..18, lane at z 0..4, doors at the plot middle, side columns as fence lines) so the modules still tile. Check with $MCD fit build.nbt --rooms rooms.json and $MCD room for every room until OK.

applied: Beds: plot 0 gets two beds in the front room (x4, x7, z10..11, lane x5..6 clear) and two in the back room. Plot 1 gets 2 beds per flat (4 total). Plot 2 gets 2 in the hall and 2 in the parlour. Plot 3 mirrors plot 0 (2 front, 2 back). All use bed(), two clear blocks above, reached from the doors; furniture rearranged inside the rooms only (room-1..8.mjs).

Plot 0 roof: removed the 3:1 andesite/birch mix, verge and eave. It is now polished_andesite for slope, ridge, eave and verge (roofs.mjs). The 56 refused writes are the same gable-fill cells as in v1.

Coop (new parts/coop.mjs, called from the shell): hen house on cobblestone stilts, floor y2, spruce walls y3..5 with stripped-log corners. Keeper door with a stair ramp and rails, plus a chicken pop-hole with its own ramp. Nest boxes of hay and barrels, a roost log, vent panes and a gable roof. A covered feed shed (4 posts, slab roof, troughs) was added in yards.mjs. The existing run fence and gate x65..66 are kept. rooms.json coop box updated to the new interior.
skipped: No sleeping loft or ladder: the extra beds fit on the floors of the existing rooms, so the roofs and trusses were left alone.
Hen house walls are 6x6 and the feed shed sits west of it. The coop does not fill the whole 12x14 plot, because the run fence, troughs and the lane to the gate need open ground.
